rv.q: Patrons, take note: your soul will thank you for taking an evening (or afternoon) to join them.
“Buddy” is a don’t miss musical that really heats up Chicagoland’s Summer Theatre scene.

About five years ago, I was privileged to review American Blues Theater’s Jeff Award-winning Buddy: The Buddy Holly Story, still one of the best shows I’ve ever seen. And as I perused the playbill for the Marriott’s current revival, names from that 2018 show jumped off the page and assured me that this production would be in capable hands.
Surrounded by its superb cast, this musical excels with theater-rocking performances that will leave you wanting more!
This is a big-hearted, high-energy production in which even folks who've never heard of Holly likely will find his music affecting and infectious.

Whether you're a Boomer who has lived all of their life with Holly's music, a younger person who only knows some of his songs, or someone who knows nothing at all about him, Buddy: The Buddy Holly Story is a joyous celebration of his heart and his talent...
My guests and I loved this production.

The show, a rocking 100 minutes without intermission, magnificently proves, once again, that Buddy Holly's musical vision, personality and ground-breaking style made him the super star that would live on past his tragic plane crash in 1959 at age 22.

cn.t: Critics rave about this joyful, energetic production, with stellar performances from the cast of actor-musicians led by Kieren McCabe's phenomenal Buddy Holly bringing the rock 'n' roll legend's music vibrantly back to life.
